title: Daily digest: Bandi Sanjay Challenges Revanth To Disso | Arrangements in place for polling in 222 | Quad ministers express ‘grave concerns’
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Bandi Sanjay Challenges Revanth To Dissolve Government, Face Ballot-Paper Polls.
Arrangements in place for polling in 222 wards across NTR districts.
Quad ministers express ‘grave concerns’ over economic coercion.
bullets_ur: Bandi Sanjay ne Revanth ko hukumat tehlil kar ke ballot paper par intikhabat larne ka challenge diya
NTR district ke 222 wards mein polling ke liye intezamat mukammal kar liye gaye.
Quad waziran ne maashi dabao par 'shadeed taway-e-fikr' ka izhar kiya hai.
